title: Figure 23: Known vs. Unknown Object Sightings by Light Brightness, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" (left) and "Unknown" (right) object sightings, in percent, by reported brightness: Sunlight on mirror or aluminum, Sunlight on plaster stone or soil, Brighter than moon, Like moon, Duller than moon and Not stated. Both axes run from 0 to 60 percent, and "Not stated" is the largest category. Caption: "FIGURE 23 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY LIGHT BRIGHTNESS, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7501.
